identifies: Abundance for specified isoforms and compartment
needed_control: Absolute/per-cell or calibrated normalization; state/composition; transcript definition

identifies: Recent synthesis under kinetic/processing assumptions; promoter-resolved run-on can address initiation
does_not_identify: A long pulse is not pure initiation and includes survival/processing
needed_control: Pulse duration, spike-ins, uptake, intron/exon/first-exon definitions, same time and biological unit

identifies: Loss of pre-labelled RNA with dilution/label recycling modeled
does_not_identify: Specific route without genetic or seed/RNase controls
needed_control: Measure cell growth, initial label, recovery and stress; selective route rescue; replicate cultures/donors

does_not_identify: Unperturbed rate or transfer to another context
needed_control: Verify block; stress/viability; independent biological replicates; orthogonal metabolic chase

does_not_identify: Native initiation or decay versus translation with luminescence alone
needed_control: Measure reporter RNA and protein/synthesis; identical promoter; mutant basal expression and unrelated miRNA controls

identifies: Association/loading relative to validated input/IP controls
does_not_identify: Turnover rate, active repression from binding alone, or endogenous loading from overexpressed AGO
needed_control: Endogenous AGO pull-down; miR29 input and bound recovery; spike-ins; functional sensor; AGO depletion/rescue

identifies: Relative occupancy per RNA only after true sample/time alignment
does_not_identify: Absolute completed protein synthesis or elongation rate
needed_control: Global calibration, sample IDs, elongation/stalling checks and target nascent-protein output
